summary: The diff splits the modules-drift gate out of baseline-check.yml into a standalone reusable modules-drift.yml workflow that runs robotsix-modules validate/check-registration/validate-paths without the AGENT.md/pre-commit baseline scaffolding. Docs already updated and consistent: README table description trimmed for baseline-check.yml and a new modules-drift.yml row added; docs/workflow-reference.md drops the has-board/python-version/uv-version inputs from the baseline-check section and adds a complete modules-drift.yml section (inputs table, caller template, consumer prerequisites). New workflow follows all repo conventions: SHA-pin with # vX.Y.Z comments, persist-credentials: false checkout, static workflow_call defaults, timeout-minutes: 15, no inline ${{ }} in run blocks. No further doc changes needed; the only remaining has-board reference is a historical CHANGELOG.md entry, correctly left untouched. Caller migrations are out of scope per the ticket.
updated_memory: Repo is a workflow-library. README.md holds a reusable-workflow table; each `X` row links to `docs/workflow-reference.md#X-yml` (dots stripped). workflow-reference.md has one `## `X.yml`` section per reusable: inputs table, secrets table, `### Caller template`, `**Consumer prerequisites:**`. Authoring conventions: every uses: = 40-char SHA + `# vX.Y.Z` comment (caller templates use `<sha-of-vX.Y.Z> # vX.Y.Z`); no inline `${{ }}` in run: (use env:); persist-credentials: false on every checkout; static workflow_call defaults (dynamic via default:"" + runtime fallback); job-level if: guards; timeout-minutes:15 fleet default; consumers add wrapper workflows triggering on push main + pull_request. CHANGELOG.md is historical — never rewrite past entries. Workflow layout: baseline-check.yml = has-docker input + single baseline job (AGENT.md/README/LICENSE/dependabot/release-please/.secrets-patterns-excluded); modules-drift.yml = standalone workflow_call with python-version(3.14)/uv-version(0.12.5), runs uv sync --frozen then robotsix-modules validate|check-registration|validate-paths docs/modules.yaml --root ., no baseline scaffolding. Also present: python-ci/security/docs, release-please, docker-release/pr-scan, scan-container, codeql, scorecard, dependency-review, config-ownership-check, lint-workflows, lint-dockerfile, mutation-test, deps-bump, bump, pin-bump, pin-bump-sweep, dependabot-auto-merge.
